# Vocabulary.com

> > Vocabulary.com is an adaptive learning platform that combines an intelligent English dictionary with engaging word games and competitive vocabulary challenges.

The site helps students, teachers, and lifelong learners master English vocabulary through interactive tools including the Vocabulary Bowl and Vocab Jam competitions. It features context-rich definitions, personalized learning algorithms, and classroom management tools for educators.
